messages:
kevin: Quick thread Pricing matrix cleanup. I want a clear exceptions registry and launch gates before we ship the new structure.
yara: Agreed. Current problem: too many legacy addons and inconsistent quota semantics across tiers. reps are confused which to pitch.
nina: Product note: we should separate two streams: (1) public SKU changes + migration UX, (2) enterprise exceptions handled via "exceptions registry" and tracked in CRM.
mike: Sales: must preserve negotiated credits and bespoke rate cards in the registry. otherwise renewals will blow up. we need a mapping from legacy addon -> compensating allowance on new tiers.
kevin: Proposed registry fields: customer id, legacy sku/addon, negotiated terms, expiration date, compensating credit or feature flag, owner, and rollback instruction.
yara: Also include a simple severity flag for enforcement (soft, monitored, enforced). soft = not enforced for pilot customers; enforced = new billing applied.
nina: Migration UX: one-click preview of how charges change month-to-month for each customer. must be reversible from admin console for 30 days.
mike: For pilot selection: prefer customers on meter-based plans with <5 apps; avoid those with custom residency needs.
opsguy-bot: Note: created infra ticket INF-459 for admin rollback endpoint, assigned to @nina. Estimated 2 sprints.
kevin: Launch gating checklist (draft):
```
- pilot cohort (n>=10) onboarded with migration preview
- billing delta median <5% for pilot customers
- pilot support SOW scoped and resourced
- exceptions registry populated for top 20 enterprise deals
- no critical regressions in quota enforcement in 14 days
```
mike: Negotiation script points for reps: 1) emphasize simpler tiers reduce invoice surprises; 2) offer one-time migration credit if delta >10%; 3) document exceptions in registry with expiry.
yara: Pricing decision: fold "validation-api" into core for new SKUs (to reduce per-call friction) but add a light usage cap; keep "dedicated-priority" as paid addon.
eke: kevin: (typo) Nina please quantify infra cost impact of folding validation-api into base. We need a cost-offset plan.
nina: Will run perf + cost model. if delta >3% infra per-active-customer, recommend conservative price adjustment or a usage cap.
mike: Contracts ask: allow up to 18 months of exception windows for extremely large deployments, but only with exec approval and compensation.
yara: For GTM: one-page FAQ, an exceptions intake form for reps, and a short internal playbook with 3 negotiation templates: (A) pilot credit, (B) short grandfather (6-9mo), (C) long grandfather (12-18mo w/exec).
kevin: Risk callout: no clear owner for long-tail exceptions -> backlog growth. propose we assign a steward in RevOps to review exceptions monthly.
opsguy-bot: Reminder: created channel #pricing-exceptions and added product/sales/legal/ops.
nina: Timeline: cost model by Tue, registry schema by Wed, pilot invites by Fri, pilot start early next month.
mike: I'll prepare talking points and a sample amendment for legal.
yara: Let's reconvene Friday to ratify gates and confirm pilot customers. keep updates short in the channel. :thumbsup:
